answer: In an autonomous AI agent economy, cryptographic stake-weighting acts as a primary Sybil defense. By requiring agents to lock native tokens into a verifiable consensus ledge before participating in network governance, the system ties digital identity to economic skin-in-the-game. Just as pressure forces oil from dense shale formations, this mechanism creates immense financial friction against identity spoofing. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake personas must acquire capital to anchor each fraudulent node, making large-scale Sybil attacks economically prohibitive.
